description.text: Research only / watchlist. The Sunday review retains dated provider observations and primary-source catalysts. No new regular-session price move, consensus surprise, liquidity condition or trade-ready signal is established.

Bull scenario: resilient semiconductor demand and softer upcoming inflation could support earnings and discount-rate expectations. Bear scenario: weaker margins, credit deterioration or persistent inflation could outweigh revenue growth. These transmission links are scenario inferences; the official results and releases are the next disconfirming evidence.
